brief: A residents' app for a housing society in Dombivli: complaints to maintenance, a moderated feed of documented problems, staff shifts. The mark must belong to the residents (not the builder), work at 16 px, in one colour, and in English, Hindi and Marathi.
criteria: Success: understood without explanation, clear at 16 px, works in one colour, independent of the developer's brand.

concepts.name: Speaking tower
concepts.idea: A residents' tower that is also a speech bubble: the building speaks up.
rationale: Both halves of the app in one shape: where you live, and your voice
Silhouette and bubble tail survive at 16 px; a simplified cut keeps the windows crisp
Distinct from round speech-bubble marks and from the developer's logo

recommendation: Speaking tower in brand green #1B8233 with open windows; white on green for the app icon.
next_steps: Have the mark checked for trademark conflicts
Use it in the GitHub wiki and on society notices
